s.zh: 抵押给深渊的灵魂被收走了，尸体化作了黑烟。
s.en: The soul pledged to the Abyss has been collected; the corpse turned into black smoke.

s.zh: 抽搐着站了起来：它的灵魂化作了怨魂，成了一只劣魔。
s.en: twitched and stood up: its soul has turned into a larva, becoming a manes.

s.zh: 一只纳巴苏趁夜色闯进了地图：灰黑的石皮、蝠翼、长獠牙。它专挑落单的人下手，被它杀死的人灵魂会被吞掉，再也无法复活。
s.en: A nabassu has broken into the map under cover of night: grey-black stony hide, bat wings, long fangs. It picks off those who are alone, and the souls of those it kills are devoured and can never be revived.

s.zh: \n\n它就是上次逃走的那一只，身上还带着
s.en: \n\nIt's the one that got away last time, still carrying
\n\nIf it's still alive at dawn, it will fly away.

s.zh: 天亮了，纳巴苏振翅飞走了
s.en: Dawn broke and the nabassu flew away

s.zh: 根本不是凡人——角、蝠翼和细尾从幻象里显了出来，是一只
s.en: , who joined recently, isn't mortal at all: horns, bat wings and a thin tail showed through the illusion. It's a

s.zh: 。最近那些“噩梦缠身”的夜晚，原来是它在吸取同床人的精力。\n\n要怎么处置它？
s.en: . Those recent nights "plagued by nightmares" were it draining the energy of whoever shared its bed.\n\nWhat will you do with it?

s.zh: 梦见自己站在深渊的边缘，有个声音一遍遍念着一个名字。醒来时，枕边多了一本用不知名的皮装订的书——
s.en: dreamed of standing at the edge of the Abyss while a voice repeated a name over and over. On waking, there was a book bound in some unknown hide beside the pillow:

s.zh: 会被深渊多染一分；烧掉它，心里会轻松一些；或者交给费伦拓荒同盟处理。
s.en: will be tainted a little more by the Abyss; burn it, and their mind will ease a little; or hand it over to the Faerûn Frontier Alliance.

s.zh: 费伦拓荒同盟和你敌对
s.en: The Faerûn Frontier Alliance is hostile to you

交给费伦拓荒同盟（好感 +10）
s.en: Give to the Faerûn Frontier Alliance (goodwill +10)

s.zh: 是一名独自流浪的旅人，想要加入你们。看起来没什么可疑的。
s.en: is a lone traveler who wants to join you. Nothing seems suspicious.

s.zh: 束缚它（服从度 50，主人是社交最高的殖民者）
s.en: Bind it (obedience 50, master is the colonist with the highest Social)

s.zh: 驱逐（它离开；和它最亲近的人心情 -8）
s.en: Banish (it leaves; the person closest to it gets mood -8)

s.zh: 位面薄得像一层纸：一道深渊裂口在殖民地外撕开了！劣魔先冲出来，然后是巴路古拉、哈兹魔，夜里还有影魔；再往后魅魔和（袭击点数够高时）炎魔也会亲自走出来。每 8 小时一波，开了 3 天不关就会崩溃。\n\n关上它：打掉裂口（600 生命）、让巨灵或六臂蛇人命令它闭合，或者用一张真名卷直接封住。关上后会留下位面残渣和恶魔血。
s.en: The planes are thin as paper: an abyssal rift has torn open outside the colony! Manes rush out first, then barlguras, hezrous, and shadow demons at night; later succubi and (with enough raid points) balors will walk out in person. A wave every 8 hours; if it stays open for 3 days it collapses.\n\nClose it: destroy the rift (600 HP), have a genie or marilith command it shut, or seal it outright with a true name scroll. Closing it leaves planar residue and demon blood.
Needs a good god as patron deity

s.zh: 在圣坛前赎回了抵押给深渊的灵魂。
s.en: redeemed the soul pledged to the Abyss before the altar.
